verdict.rationale: Vapi is an API-driven platform, so issuing scoped API credentials is a fair question, but the evidence pack never documents scoped, restricted, or least-privilege API keys. The enterprise RBAC and SSO mentions cover user access control, an adjacent feature that does not show per-agent credential scoping. The CLI organization switching and the MCP server do not show credential scoping either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
